svg.title: Caduceus — components inside every daemon
svg.desc: Component diagram with task coordination, deterministic scheduler, ephemeral worker registry, P2P task transport, worker admission, prompt executor, OpenAI-compatible client, file store, availability policy, telemetry, ordered heartbeats, optional enrollment, allowlist, libp2p identity and cross-cutting configuration and logging. Solid arrows show calls or results. Dashed arrows show supporting state. The three panels share the same daemon runtime.
svg.text: Logical components within one caduceusd process · the same runtime is present on requester and worker nodes
Used for local AND remote tasks
Incoming peer assignment via same transport
Recovery restores work, not live workers
The task stream carries remote events and token deltas. MCP/CLI expose stored events; there is no separate active event bus.
Opaque policy state; policy also gates worker admission
Config YAML · node private key · group hash/key · control token → runtime policies and endpoints
Cross-cutting: logging → stderr (JSON/text). Embedded schemas define MCP tools/resources and protocol data. OS services start the daemon.
Current limits: tray binary is a placeholder; GPU/activity providers are not wired; prompt runner returns no generated artifacts. No exactly-once guarantee.
* Approval is required by default when enrollment is enabled. Group hash is not a credential. No private key or reusable invitation secret is sent in approval.
